title: C# and .NET conventions
summary: C# and .NET coding conventions (.NET 8+, file-scoped namespaces, nullable types, naming). Pairs with the dotnet plugins.
details: Claude follows C# and .NET conventions in your code: .NET 8 or newer, file-scoped namespaces, nullable reference types, global usings, top-level statements and the field and member naming rules. It is for anyone working on C# or .NET projects, and pairs with the dotnet plugins. It adds one plain-text rule file under ~/.claude/rules/ that loads into every session; no code runs and no network is used.
risk: Text only, loaded into every session. No code runs.
